plotEn:
Following the defeat of Victoria Vance , and while out at sea, the Paw Patrol saves the boat captain Dave and his family from a boat fire where Marshall makes a daring rescue of the family's pet cat. Marshall then tells Chase of his belief that rescue pups don't make mistakes.
As the team continues their journey, they end up caught in a storm and are washed up on an uncharted island that did not appear on their map. Ryder gives the pups new survival gear before they explore the island, but Marshall accidentally awakens a sleeping Spinosaurus. As the Spinosaurus chases them, they are saved by a wheelchair-using Bernese Mountain Dog puppy named Rex, who knows how to communicate with the dinosaurs, including his Tyrannosaurus friend Timmy. The pups are surprised and initially scared to learn that dinosaurs are still alive on the island and Rex reveals that he was also afraid of them when he crash landed on the island two years ago, but took the time to befriend them while also using the island's resources to build a large treehouse. As Rex shows the Paw Patrol around the island, the team befriends the dinosaurs and Ryder realizes they have made a huge scientific discovery. The team chooses to inform the public.
In Adventure City, Mayor Humdinger is released from prison alongside the Kitten Catastrophe Crew. Initially claiming to be a changed man, Humdinger quickly reverts to his old ways when he sees a television news report of the Paw Patrol discovering the island and naming it
